text: Standard insulation levels (Um / power frequency / lightning impulse): 420 kV / 1,050 kV (switching) / 1,425 kV; 12 kV / 28 kV / 75 kV for the 10.5 kV system; the generator terminal equipment per IEC 60034 and the IEC busduct data. The levels shall be confirmed by the insulation coordination study.
